questions.questionText: When the status of a policy or law is uncertain, which approach should be preferred?
options: Assuming a draft is enacted law
Applying a rule outside its scope
Checking the current official text and scope of a legal instrument
Relying on a paraphrase without verification
questions.explanation: "Checking the current official text and scope of a legal instrument" is the most appropriate choice for this practice item on Educational law and policy. It aligns with defensible professional judgement in educational law and policy. The other options describe weaker, incomplete, or contrary approaches. This is an original GigaLearn practice question — verify any policy or legal detail against current GES and Ministry of Education sources.
